name: Publish Crates

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      crates:
        description: 'Crates to publish (comma-separated)'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - ic-asset
          - icx-asset
          - ic-asset,icx-asset

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  # When getting Rust dependencies, retry on network error:
  CARGO_NET_RETRY: 10
  # Use the local .curlrc
  CURL_HOME: .
  # Disable DFX telemetry
  DFX_TELEMETRY: 'off'
  # Use the stable toolchain for publishing
  RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: stable

jobs:
  publish:
    name: publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          cache: true
          cache-workspaces: true

      - name: Install cargo-release
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-release

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "${{ github.actor }}"
          git config user.email "${{ github.actor }}@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Publish crates
        run: |
          # Determine which crates to publish
          CRATES="${{ github.event.inputs.crates }}"
          IFS=',' read -ra CRATE_ARRAY <<< "$CRATES"
          
          for crate in "${CRATE_ARRAY[@]}"; do
            case "$crate" in
              "ic-asset")
                echo "Publishing ic-asset..."
                cargo release publish --package ic-asset --token ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
                ;;
              "icx-asset")
                echo "Publishing icx-asset..."
                cargo release publish --package icx-asset --token ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
                ;;
              *)
                echo "Unknown crate: $crate"
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          done
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
